svg.title: Standardization changes location and scale, not the shape of the observed distribution

cc:Work.dc:title: Standardization changes location and scale, not the shape of the observed distribution
cc:Work.dc:description: Four observations at zero and one each at 1, 2, 4, and 8. Bar heights and relative positions are identical after standardizing; only the horizontal axis units change.
